parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type. Valid values:
- **en**: English.
- **zh**: Chinese.

parameters.name: PageName
parameters.description:
The page name. Valid values:
- **overview**: overview page
- **access**: access control page
- **switch**: firewall page.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request.

parameters.name: TabName
parameters.description: The name of the protected object in the access control policy.
